_about: The Credential Catalog's analysis for faculty (kb/_build_adopt_align.py): per settled credential with issuer-published skill areas, the harvested course outcomes of its articulating colleges and a lexical alignment score. Illustrative: a word-overlap cosine between a skill area and an outcome; covered = skill areas with an outcome at 0.2 or more; confidence = covered / skill areas. The Foundation and ASCCC method, or a TypeSafe Jev Score per skill area, replaces the score here; faculty verify every alignment before it counts.
